bear_case: Korea's sell-on-Samsung-news reaction is the data point that commands the most weight in today's morning assessment. The Samsung Blue House ceremony — a $648B national strategic commitment with presidential, Samsung, and SK Hynix leadership on stage simultaneously — is the largest positive fundamental catalyst in Korean semiconductor history. KOSPI fell 3.05% (intraday -5.81%) on the announcement. SK Hynix, the session's most direct beneficiary, opened -1.83% below its long entry threshold. This is the fourth consecutive major positive catalyst absorbed by institutional distribution since June 22 (PCE in-line June 25, reconstitution $334B June 26, Samsung Blue House June 29). The pattern is structural: active selling overpowers passive and fundamental buying at every inflection point. ES at 7,455 pre-market is 4.75 points below the 7,460 regime floor, and $165B of institutional quarter-end selling is the session's dominant flow. VIX at 16.41 is the most promising development in weeks — but it requires a CLOSE below 17, then a second CLOSE, before any regime indicator formally clears. If SPX cannot sustain a close above 7,460 today into $165B of institutional selling, the 7,300 BEARISH escalation level becomes the next decision point before NFP on July 2. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously today — upgrade to HOLD. Both gates clearing on the same session before June 30 quarter-end would mark the first regime improvement in seven sessions.
